title: Mahj Mondays at the Gillioz
seo_title: Mahj Mondays at the Gillioz in Springfield, MO
description: Mahj Mondays at the Gillioz takes place on Monday, November 16, 2026, from 5:30 PM to 8:30 PM at The Gallery at the Gillioz Theatre, 325 Park Central E. in Springfield, MO. Admission is free, and this social, arts-minded evening is open to a general audience.
venue: The Gallery at the Gillioz Theatre
